0 から 1。Groq は 0 を推奨しています。

Groq model ID, e.g. \"openai/gpt-oss-20b: Groq model ID, e.g. "openai/gpt-oss-20b". Use List Models to find the IDs on this account.
The conversation as a JSON array of mess: The conversation as a JSON array of messages, oldest first, e.g. [{"role": "system", "content": "Be brief."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]. Roles: system, user, assistant, tool.
Upper limit on generated tokens, reasoni: Upper limit on generated tokens, reasoning included. Defaults to the model maximum.
Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. Lower: Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. Lower is more focused. Defaults to 1.
Nucleus sampling from 0 to 1. Set this o: Nucleus sampling from 0 to 1. Set this or Temperature, not both. Defaults to 1.
Up to 4 strings that end generation. The: Up to 4 strings that end generation. The reply does not include them.
Best-effort deterministic sampling: repe: Best-effort deterministic sampling: repeat calls with the same seed and inputs tend to match.
Forces a JSON reply matching this schema: Forces a JSON reply matching this schema (Structured Outputs), as {"name": "...", "schema": {...}, "strict": true}. Only some models support it. Leave empty for plain text.
Functions the model may call, as a JSON: Functions the model may call, as a JSON array in the OpenAI format: [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "...", "description": "...", "parameters": {...}}}].
\"auto\" lets the model decide, \"requir: "auto" lets the model decide, "required" forces a tool call, "none" forbids one. Defaults to "auto" when tools are given.
For reasoning models only: none, default: For reasoning models only: none, default, low, medium or high. Supported values differ per model.
For reasoning models only: \"parsed\" re: For reasoning models only: "parsed" returns reasoning in its own field, "raw" keeps it in the content, "hidden" drops it.
Any other request body fields from the G: Any other request body fields from the Groq API reference, as a JSON object. The dedicated inputs above override keys set here.
The text the model responds to. For a li: The text the model responds to. For a list of input items, leave this empty and set "input" in Additional Fields.
A system message placed first in the mod: A system message placed first in the model context.
Upper limit on generated tokens, reasoni: Upper limit on generated tokens, reasoning included.

For reasoning models only: low, medium o: For reasoning models only: low, medium or high.
Forces a JSON reply matching this schema: Forces a JSON reply matching this schema, as {"name": "...", "schema": {...}, "strict": true}. Leave empty for plain text.
Functions the model may call, as a JSON: Functions the model may call, as a JSON array: [{"type": "function", "name": "...", "description": "...", "parameters": {...}}]. Up to 128.
Voice name for the model, e.g. \"troy\",: Voice name for the model, e.g. "troy", "austin" or "hannah" for English.
flac, mp3, mulaw, ogg or wav. Defaults t: flac, mp3, mulaw, ogg or wav. Defaults to wav.
Playback speed of the generated audio. 1: Playback speed of the generated audio. 1 is normal.
The audio file: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mp: The audio file: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav or webm, up to 25 MB. Give either this or Audio URL, not both.

Text that guides spelling and style, in: Text that guides spelling and style, in the language of the audio.
Sampling temperature from 0 to 1. Groq r: Sampling temperature from 0 to 1. Groq recommends 0, the default.
\"json\" returns the text; \"verbose_jso: "json" returns the text; "verbose_json" adds language, duration and timed segments. Defaults to "json".
